# Maia Construction

> A licensed and insured home exterior contractor (MA HIC #204634) working out of Charlton, Massachusetts. Founded in 2015 by Marcos Alves. Siding installation, window replacement and door installation for homes across Massachusetts, using our own crews rather than subcontractors.

Maia Construction works on the outside of houses only: siding, windows, doors,
and the trim, soffit, fascia and flashing that tie them together. We do not
take on interior remodelling, kitchens, bathrooms, basement finishing or home
additions — if that is what you need, we are the wrong call and will say so.

Rated 5.0 across 19 verified Google reviews. Over 500 projects completed since
2015. Every project carries the manufacturer's material warranty (25–50 years
depending on the product) plus a 5-year workmanship warranty from us. Estimates
are free and written, and we file the permits and attend the inspections.

Based at 13 Stoneybrook Rd, Charlton, MA 01507. Phone (508) 859-9880, Monday to
Saturday 7:00 AM – 7:00 PM. Email contact@maiaconstruction.com.

## Services

- [Siding installation](https://maiaconstruction.com/services/siding/): Insulated vinyl, James Hardie fiber cement, engineered wood and cedar shingle. Full tear-off, sheathing and rot repair, drainable housewrap, trim and fascia. Certified installer for James Hardie, CertainTeed and Alside. Typically $12,000–$28,000 for a single-family exterior.
- [Window replacement](https://maiaconstruction.com/services/windows/): ENERGY STAR double and triple-pane units, full-frame and insert replacement, custom sizing for out-of-square openings in older homes, bedroom egress compliance, sill pan flashing. Roughly $650–$1,400 per opening installed.
- [Door installation](https://maiaconstruction.com/services/doors/): Fiberglass and insulated steel entry doors, sliding and French patio doors, storm doors, sidelights and transoms, threshold and framing repair. Therma-Tru, ProVia and Andersen. Roughly $1,800–$5,500 installed.
- [Exterior general contracting](https://maiaconstruction.com/services/general-contractor/): Siding, windows and doors taken as one contract with one crew, so flashing details do not fall between trades. Porch and entry rebuilds, structural repair of exterior walls, permit management. Exterior only.

## Service area

- [Cities we serve](https://maiaconstruction.com/cities/): Full directory. We cover 100+ Massachusetts communities across Middlesex, Worcester, Norfolk, Essex, Suffolk, Plymouth and Bristol counties, plus parts of southern New Hampshire.

Cities closest to the Charlton shop include Framingham, Natick, Hudson,
Sudbury, Southborough, Northborough, Shrewsbury, Worcester, Westborough,
Marlborough, Auburn and Grafton. Distance matters mainly for how quickly we can
get back out for a warranty call or meet an inspector on site.
